question: Who among the following Bengal Nawabs transferred his capital from Murshidabad to Munger?
solution:
The correct answer is __Mir Kasim.__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** 

 
• Mir Qasim granted the zamindari of Burdwan, Midnapore, and Chittagong to the British.
 
• He transferred the capital from Murshidabad to Munger in1762.
 
• He fought the Battle of Buxar (Oct. 1764) against Munro in alliance with Shah Alam II and Shuja-ud-daula.
 
• He attempted to modernize the army, established firelocks and a gun-factory at Munger.
 
• He after being defeated at Buxar, signed the Treaty of Allahabad with the British in 1765 and later on fled to Awadh.
